# [Skill title]

## Purpose

Testing and reviewing code

## When to Use

- When the user asks to test and review the code

## Instructions

1. Write tests for code covering also the edge cases
2. Run these tests
3. Analyze the tests result and write a review of the code, if the tests pasted and why not if they didn't
3. A table of the passed and failed tests and a thourough review of the code.
